name: ebda-sites
description: Hidden preview landing sites for Ebda AI Studio sub-brands (events, marketing, design).

scripts.typecheck: node --check scripts/build.mjs && node --check lib/render.mjs && node --check lib/contact.js
scripts.deploy: node scripts/build.mjs && for s in events marketing design; do (cd sites/$s && wrangler deploy) || exit 1; done
